gopalswamy2013.height_unit: solar radius as reported, heliocentric distance from Sun center; no new meter conversion selected

metric_type_II.onset_correction_basis: Direct inspection of Hiraiso, Culgoora and Learmonth dynamic spectra.
metric_type_II.fitted_circle_reference: height above solar surface for an initial spherical-expansion construction
metric_type_II.shock_proxy_assumption: Fast-event separation between flux rope/CME and shock taken small; this is a CME-height proxy for shock formation, not a resolved shock surface.

particle_release.onset_method: Various smoothing levels of pressure-corrected one-minute Oulu count rates; median onset occurs at2percent of peak enhancement.
particle_release.normalization_note: The quoted release time is normalized to the remote-sensing electromagnetic timing; it is not the unshifted physical solar-emission clock.

height_uncertainty.policy: Do not turn rounded reported heights or the onset interval into a Gaussian error or a fitted acceptance tolerance.

rouillard2016_alternative.method: Velocity-dispersion regression of multi-species near-Earth onset time against inverse relativistic beta, with intercept as release time and slope as path length.

reported_uncertainty_statements.notation: physical solar release01:29 plus/minus1min UT before light-travel shift

rouillard2016_alternative.use: Separate inference alternative, never averaged with or silently substituted for the Gopalswamy time/height pair.
rouillard2016_alternative.background_topology: The paper links the near-Earth particle path to a pre-existing magnetic cloud; replacing it with a fixed nominal Parker path is a separate model assumption.

scoring.reason: No published numeric height covariance and no reconciled common release-time uncertainty/clock prescription; do not invent an observational tolerance or new source forcing.
